title: Prove a two-delivery price floor for the selected BIT word
body:
## Summary

Every original paid arrival in the selected PR7001 BIT word retains its old minimum price when replaced by at most two direct nested deliveries from strictly earlier chart libraries. The scope grants free retention and destination XOR, keeps all independent inputs and old deadlines, and covers both orientations for the tariff `s^t`, `0 < t <= 1`. This is a scoped proof backed by exhaustive finite replay. No new κ follows. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19717637)

A strictly improving bundle must have total rank below the original rank. The sum of all individually lower-rank donor libraries and the free destination library excludes 5,733 of 5,742 arrivals, regardless of bundle size. The remaining nine are forward rank-seven arrivals into chart 0. Quotienting by the free destination library excludes all 4,626 eligible singletons and 478,764 rank-affordable pairs in those nine cases.

## Evidence

The replay authenticates the PR7001 native word, derives rational nesting and reconstructs the original causal rows before testing each arrival. A joint-span control detects a row attainable by two donors together when neither can supply it individually. A strict-budget control excludes equal-rank-sum pairs from the cheaper domain. Both direct modes passed locally in 1.32 seconds each. The registered replay and committed-byte/source-history preflight also passed.

From the repository root, with CPython 3.12.15 and its standard library, run the following commands.

```sh
python3.12 -B -W error -X dev research/bit-causal-multi-delivery/verify.py
python3.12 -B -W error -X dev -O research/bit-causal-multi-delivery/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-causal-multi-delivery
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-causal-multi-delivery --check-source-history
```

The direct checks report `PASS_BIT_CAUSAL_MULTI_DELIVERY arrivals=5742 union_excluded=5733 exceptional_singles=4626 exceptional_pairs=478764`.

## Scope and limitations

The proof fixes the original libraries, required rows, deadlines, charts and productive targets. The higher-arity search at the nine exceptions remains open. Intermediate relays, adaptive library changes, helper restrictions, and physical compiler delivery, retention and restoration are outside the model. The selected cold replay, predecessor scientific suites, Lean, Docker, and independent human or formal proof-kernel review were not run.

The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit aliromman for the fixed-library model and the multiple-delivery question in PR #7723, CubeJerry for PR #7001, zxv and the retained authors for the native word, DreamingOfClouds for the chain-root caller, and ToikY for the related causal stock bounds. [Pinned predecessor proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a4fd22c08058c0fef830306b2d46e4a51f091939/research/bit-causal-delivery-rank-obstruction/PROOF.md)

## Open next questions

- Test three or more donors at the nine exceptions. Start at forward event 26861 with a donor subset of total rank at most six.
- Test a changed causal library from one intermediate relay. Specify its entry, delivery and restoration costs before pricing a complete caller.

## Related open work

- #7723 proves the single-delivery floor for the same word. This result permits destination XOR and two donors.
- #7293 bounds original same-chart reuse at fixed deadlines. This result also permits strictly earlier retained stock and direct paid donors.
- #7200 bounds strict-subchart stocks for adjusted deliveries of the eight-port retag. This result uses the original arrival rows.
- #7306 bounds single-chart stocks for that retag, including nonnested charts. This result allows paired donors and requires nesting.
- #7289 changes destination assignments under balanced ingress constraints. This result keeps the old destinations.
- #7272 studies exterior injectivity with changed carrier payloads and a fixed suffix. This result keeps the original required row.
- #7273 allows late exterior correction for changed carrier payloads. This result tests fixed-deadline direct reconstruction.
- #7275 allows ordinary corrections at first observers. This result keeps the original row and library.
- #7720 tests one cocharted helper relation with original paid paths. This result keeps helper inputs independent.
- #7722 tests joint helper relations within a boundary group and keeps paid paths fixed. This result changes the allowed paid path.
- #7733 optimizes simultaneous block-local restrictions with fixed paid forms. This result treats the original independent-input contract.
- #7177 changes the paired caller's QUERY and LOCAL phases. This result bounds original native deliveries.

## CI notes

This PR carries the shared CI-doc and replay-gap sync used by other open PRs.

The base fails `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` because the guide names `make frontier6030-verify` while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The shared sync updates the guide and runs the triggered historical replay against its pinned snapshot.

The six navigation tests and the registered historical replay passed locally on CPython 3.12.15. Hosted CI passed all three checks on `7e44f44b8078b3788256772533890fbf85503a0c`. The plan, BIT multi-delivery replay and historical replay-gap replay all passed. [Run 44394177520](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44394177520)

## Merge danger

Two-way. The patch adds a standalone proof and replay with one pinned input.
